controles.affirmation: TITRE : « La defense par les brevets d'EYLEA recule en Europe et N'A PAS TENU AUX ETATS-UNIS ».
controles.verbatim_source: On September 23, 2024, the court denied the Company's motion for a preliminary injunction, which decision was affirmed by the Federal Circuit on March 14, 2025. On June 17, 2025, the Company filed an additional patent infringement lawsuit against Amgen [...] alleging that Amgen's continued commercialization of its aflibercept 2 mg biosimilar infringes the Company's U.S. Patent No. 12,331,099.
controles.correction_proposee: Le document ne rapporte AUCUNE invalidation ni defaite au fond aux Etats-Unis : seule une demande d'injonction PRELIMINAIRE a ete rejetee (23 septembre 2024, confirmee le 14 mars 2025), les actions en contrefacon de 2024 et 2025 restant pendantes. Reformuler : « n'a pas empeche le lancement d'un biosimilaire aux Etats-Unis, la demande d'injonction preliminaire ayant ete rejetee ». Le mot « recule » reste exact pour l'Europe.

controles.affirmation: Amgen a forme le 12 septembre 2025 des demandes reconventionnelles alleguant que Regeneron aurait obtenu de nombreux brevets frauduleusement et viole le Sherman Act (presente au present, sans mention du denouement).
controles.verbatim_source: On July 7, 2026, the court granted the Company's motion to dismiss Amgen's affirmative defenses and counterclaims challenged in the 2025 lawsuit with the exception of Amgen's prosecution delay affirmative defense and counterclaim.
controles.correction_proposee: L'ATT omet un denouement anterieur a la publication du 10-Q et largement favorable a Regeneron. Ajouter : « le 7 juillet 2026, le tribunal a fait droit a la demande de rejet de Regeneron sur les moyens contestes, a l'exception du moyen tire du retard de procedure de delivrance. » Laisser une allegation de fraude sur brevets au present sans son rejet est la faute la plus lourde de cette ATT.

controles.affirmation: Une nouvelle plainte qui tam descellee le 18 juin 2026 et amendee le 20 juillet 2026, citee parmi « plusieurs procedures FEDERALES lourdes ».
controles.verbatim_source: On May 22, 2026 and June 17, 2026, respectively, the United States and the applicable states notified the court of their decisions to decline to intervene in the case. On June 18, 2026, the United States District Court for the Central District of California unsealed the qui tam complaint. On July 20, 2026, the plaintiff filed an amended complaint.
controles.correction_proposee: Point decisif omis : les Etats-Unis (22 mai 2026) et les Etats concernes (17 juin 2026) ont REFUSE d'intervenir. L'action est donc poursuivie par le seul plaignant prive. Presenter comme « procedure federale lourde » une action que l'Etat federal a declinee est exactement le type d'exageration vise. Reformuler : « une plainte qui tam, dans laquelle les Etats-Unis et les Etats concernes ont refuse d'intervenir, descellee le 18 juin 2026 et amendee le 20 juillet 2026, poursuivie par le seul plaignant prive. »

controles.affirmation: Des poursuites d'assureurs (UnitedHealthcare, Humana, Blue Cross Blue Shield du Massachusetts et autres) fondees sur la loi RICO, presentees comme un contentieux actif « empile ».
controles.verbatim_source: On December 29, 2021, the lawsuits filed by UHC and Humana were stayed by the SDNY pending resolution of the proceedings before the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts concerning the allegations in the June 2020 Civil Complaint. On September 27, 2022, the lawsuits filed by BCBS, MMO, and Horizon were stayed by the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts [...] and, in light of these stays, the parties to the Local 464A action have also agreed to stay that matter.
controles.correction_proposee: Toutes ces procedures sont SUSPENDUES (stayed) depuis 2021-2022, dans l'attente du denouement de la procedure liee a la plainte de juin 2020. Ajouter : « toutes suspendues dans l'attente du denouement de la procedure liee a la plainte de juin 2020 ». Un contentieux suspendu n'est pas un contentieux actif.

controles.affirmation: La societe a gagne 406,8 M$ de dommages devant un jury contre Amgen en mai 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: On May 15, 2025, the jury reached a verdict in Regeneron's favor on nine of the ten counts submitted to it and awarded Regeneron $135.6 million in compensatory damages and $271.2 million in punitive damages. On June 20, 2025, Amgen filed a post-trial motion for judgment as a matter of law or, in the alternative, for a new trial. [...] An oral hearing on Amgen's and Regeneron's respective post-trial motions was held on August 27, 2025.
controles.correction_proposee: Le verdict de premiere instance n'est pas definitif : le document ne rapporte aucune decision sur les requetes post-proces d'Amgen (jugement nonobstant verdict ou nouveau proces), entendues le 27 aout 2025. Reformuler : « un jury a rendu le 15 mai 2025 un verdict favorable a Regeneron (135,6 M$ compensatoires + 271,2 M$ punitifs), montants encore soumis aux requetes post-proces d'Amgen, non tranchees a ce jour. » Le caveat figure dans le champ preuve mais pas dans l'argument lu par l'investisseur.

controles.affirmation: « L'approbation par la FDA de la seringue preremplie d'EYLEA HD, que la societe presente comme un accelerateur possible de ses ventes » ; « une seringue preremplie est en cours d'examen ».
controles.verbatim_source: there can be no assurance that these enhancements (including potential FDA approval of the EYLEA HD pre-filled syringe) will help accelerate any potential future growth of EYLEA HD net product sales. — et : "the October 2025 CRL concerning our regulatory application seeking approval of the EYLEA HD pre-filled syringe, which has delayed further the potential FDA approval of the EYLEA HD pre-filled syringe"
controles.correction_proposee: Deux ecarts. (1) La societe ecrit qu'« il ne peut y avoir aucune assurance » que ces ameliorations accelerent la croissance : lui attribuer de la presenter comme « un accelerateur possible de ses ventes » inverse sa position. (2) L'ATT omet la lettre de reponse complete (CRL) d'octobre 2025 qui a retarde l'approbation : « en cours d'examen » masque un refus intermediaire. Reformuler : « seringue preremplie ayant fait l'objet d'un CRL en octobre 2025, approbation visee d'ici fin 2026, la societe indiquant qu'aucune assurance ne peut etre donnee qu'elle accelere les ventes. »

controles.affirmation: Plainte civile du DOJ de juin 2020 visant le soutien de Regeneron a des fondations d'aide aux patients, toujours en cours.
controles.verbatim_source: the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts alleging violations of the federal Anti-Kickback Statute and asserting causes of action under the federal False Claims Act and state law (the "June 2020 Civil Complaint") relating to the Company's support of 501(c)(3) organizations that provide financial assistance to patients.

controles.affirmation: Plainte civile de mars 2024 en intervention partielle du DOJ sur des taux de remboursement d'EYLEA pretendument gonfles ; demande de rejet refusee le 29 avril 2025 ; une dizaine d'Etats se sont joints.
controles.verbatim_source: On April 29, 2025, the court denied the Company's motion to dismiss the March 2024 Civil Complaint and the June 2024 Civil Complaint. On June 18, 2025, the States of Maine, Nebraska, Ohio, Oregon, and Wyoming intervened in the action and filed a consolidated complaint asserting causes of action under their respective state laws. [6 Etats en juin 2024 + 5 en juin 2025 = 11]

controles.affirmation: L'OEB a revoque le brevet EP 2 944 306 le 26 novembre 2024 puis invalide le brevet EP 3 384 049 le 21 avril 2026 ; en Allemagne, l'injonction preliminaire contre Sandoz de janvier 2026 a ete suspendue en appel des fevrier 2026 et retiree ; audience d'appel en octobre 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: On November 26, 2024, following an oral hearing, the OD announced its decision to revoke the '306 Patent. An oral hearing concerning the Company's appeal of this decision has been scheduled for October 2026. [...] On April 21, 2026, following an oral hearing, the OD invalidated the '049 Patent. [...] Following an appeal by Sandoz, in February 2026 the Munich Higher Regional Court suspended enforcement of, and the Company subsequently withdrew its request for, the preliminary injunction.

controles.affirmation: Regeneron a assigne Sanofi en novembre 2024 pour manquement a son obligation d'acces aux informations de commercialisation de Dupixent ; demande de rejet de Sanofi refusee le 17 mars 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: On November 18, 2024, the Company filed a lawsuit (as amended on December 20, 2024) in the SDNY against Sanofi [...] concerning Sanofi's obligation to provide Regeneron with full access to material information relating to the commercialization of Dupixent [...] On March 17, 2026, the court denied Sanofi's motion to dismiss the complaint.

controles.affirmation: Actions en responsabilite produit depuis 2025 alleguant que Dupixent aurait cause ou aggrave des lymphomes T cutanes, regroupees le 4 juin 2026 devant le tribunal federal du New Jersey, plus une action collective du 17 juillet 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: Since 2025, a number of product liability lawsuits have been filed [...] claiming that Dupixent either caused or exacerbated the patients' T-cell lymphoma [...] On June 4, 2026, the JPML issued an order transferring the federal lawsuits to the District of New Jersey for coordinated pretrial proceedings. On July 17, 2026, two plaintiffs filed a putative class action lawsuit in the United States District Court for the District of Maryland.

controles.affirmation: Les provisions pour risques n'etaient pas significatives au 30 juin 2026 et, pour certains risques juges raisonnablement possibles, la perte n'est pas estimable.
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, the Company's accruals for loss contingencies were not material. There are certain loss contingencies that the Company deems reasonably possible for which the possible loss or range of possible loss is not estimable at this time.

controles.affirmation: Echec de Phase 3 du fianlimab annonce en mai 2026 ; action collective du 16 juillet 2026 contre la societe et certains salaries au titre de ce programme.
controles.verbatim_source: in May 2026, we announced that a Phase 3 trial evaluating fianlimab in combination with Libtayo in first-line metastatic melanoma did not reach statistical significance for its primary endpoint compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy. [...] On July 16, 2026, a purported shareholder filed a putative class action civil complaint [...] The complaint asserts violations of federal securities laws in connection with statements or disclosures purportedly related to the Company's fianlimab clinical development program.

controles.affirmation: Actions de classe A a dix voix, 14,9 % des droits de vote combines au 31 decembre 2025 ; les deux copresidents du conseil sont aussi DG et directeur scientifique ; plainte derivee du 22 juillet 2025 contestant la remuneration des administrateurs non salaries.
controles.verbatim_source: Holders of Class A Stock [...] are entitled to ten votes per share, while holders of Common Stock are entitled to one vote per share. As of December 31, 2025, holders of Class A Stock held 14.9% of the combined voting power of all shares of Common Stock and Class A Stock then outstanding. These shareholders, if acting together, would be in a position to substantially influence the election of our directors [...] On July 22, 2025, an alleged shareholder filed a shareholder derivative complaint in the NY Supreme Court, naming the current non-employee members of the Company's board of directors, and the co-Chairs of the Company's board of directors (who also serve as Regeneron's President and Chief Executive Officer and Regeneron's President and Chief Scientific Officer, respectively).

controles.affirmation: Accords d'avril 2026 avec le gouvernement americain : prix Medicaid plafonnes au prix pays le plus favorise, TrumpRx.gov pour Praluent, Otarmeni gratuit, exemption des droits de douane Section 232 jusqu'en janvier 2029 ; la societe ecrit que ces accords entraineront vraisemblablement une baisse des prix et des remboursements.
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2026 [...] we entered into the U.S. Government Agreements [...] to provide certain of our products that we wholly own in the United States to the Medicaid program at prices no greater than [...] Most-Favored-Nation Pricing [...] to participate in a direct purchasing platform, TrumpRx.gov [...] and to provide our recently FDA-approved gene therapy Otarmeni for free in the United States. The U.S. Government Agreements further provide that Regeneron's products will not face tariffs as a result of the investigation under Section 232 [...] through January 2029 [...] The U.S. Government Agreements will likely result [...] in reduced prices and reimbursement for certain of our current and future marketed products.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE : ventes americaines d'EYLEA en baisse de 45 % au T2 2026 et de 41 % sur le semestre ; EYLEA HD + EYLEA a 1 008,5 M$ contre 1 147,5 M$ (-12,1 %).
controles.verbatim_source: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, EYLEA U.S. net product sales declined by 45% and 41%, respectively, compared to the corresponding periods in 2025 [...] Total EYLEA HD and EYLEA U.S. 1,008.5 1,147.5 1,950.0 2,190.3

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE : la collaboration Sanofi represente 48 % du chiffre d'affaires du S1 2026 contre 39 % un an plus tot ; quote-part de 33 % des ventes nettes Dupixent et Kevzara.
controles.verbatim_source: For the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, Sanofi collaboration revenue (most of which is attributable to our share of profits from the commercialization of Dupixent) represented 48% and 39% of our total revenues, respectively.
